<thought>By analyzing the measured resistances between all node pairs, I found that they are consistent with a simple series chain of four resistors. Assigning R1 = 5 Ω between X1 and N_b1, R2 = 10 Ω between N_b1 and N_b2, R3 = 15 Ω between N_b2 and N_b3, and R4 = 20 Ω between N_b3 and X2 reproduces every measured resistance (including the indirect ones obtained by summing series resistances). This satisfies the requirement of four resistors labeled left‑to‑right as R1…R4.</thought>
